scripts.prepackage: npm --prefix ../.. run check:toolchain && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs --profile debug
scripts.prepackage:release: npm --prefix ../.. run check:toolchain && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs --profile release
scripts.test:update: node --test shell/updater.test.js shell/update-channels.test.js shell/update-preferences.test.js shell/update-install-guard.test.js shell/portable-update.test.js shell/portable-helper.test.js

scripts.prepackage:local: npm --prefix ../.. run check:toolchain && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs --profile debug
